source_evidence: Exact player dialogue: 'A nation biting the palm held out to helps them creates a sure way to have that palm become a fist. They cant afford attacks from both sides. And like it or not Crownsunder is the best buffer Ossent has.' V advances a strategic mutual-interest argument during the already secured exploratory audience. Councillor independently answers within his previously established authority and favorable recommendation, clarifying prospective safeguards only. No new roll, political assent, authorized threats, disclosure, binding terms or V commitment.  V responds exactly 'A nation biting the palm held out to helps them creates a sure way to have that palm become a fist. They cant afford attacks from both sides. And like it or not Crownsunder is the best buffer Ossent has.' The councillor acknowledges the strategic incentive for Crownsunder to avoid simultaneous hostilities and the value to Ossent of an independent Crownsunder resisting Veyran expansion, without conceding recognition, accepting V's assessment as verified military intelligence, or interpreting it as an authorized threat. He distinguishes mutual interest from enforceable safeguards. In the existing favorable recommendation secured by prior Persuasion18, he proposes for Crown consideration a strictly reciprocal exchange of independently corroborated warnings about actual attacks and coercive operations, withholding troop positions/fortress dispositions, with ability for either Crown to suspend exchanges if misused. He is willing to recommend discussing that limited arrangement without first resolving the rival throne dispute; this is not repeal of Ossent's existing claim-suspension policy, formal royal approval, a treaty or additional immediate liaison authorization. No new opposed concession or roll; prior DC22 immediate liaison not earned. He asks whether V will permit faithful confidential copies of the Kestrel records to support his recommendation; no copy permission yet, originals and physical exhibits remain with party, no new claim about provenance or perpetrator. Await V's response.
pending_action: D326~11:50 private audience chamber, Royal Palace, Orsaven, V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar together; coach/four horses safely at Copper Hart. V expressly elects to pursue hereditary recovery grant for the western Ossent abandoned service house. Crown land-disposition officer prepares the written conditional instrument on the previously offered terms, obtains ordinary competent Crown countersignature and records V's acceptance; V receives the signed conditional recovery instrument and registrar retains official counterpart. Scope is the registered Crown-held abandoned service house and immediate disused grounds associated with the collapsed crossing depicted in authenticated survey; exact acreage/boundary to be verified in ordinary site inspection before deed. Instrument authorizes lawful inspection/reclamation of Crown-held parcel subject to existing household/public rights, and commits issuance of hereditary deed upon fulfillment: secure actual hazards by removal/containment/safe isolation; protect ferrier household dwelling, access, landing and return-channel usage, remedy damage directly caused by recovery; confirm parcel and actual safety/access conditions through competent Crown inspection or adequate evidence. Zero purchase price, deposit, bond, rent, mandatory full rebuilding, minimum capital investment, Crown service or fixed completion deadline. Ordinary applicable taxes/law after acquisition; no special exemptions, water monopoly, toll authority, forced tenancy or title to disputed artifacts or occupied dwelling. Routine officials handle recording; no arbitrary repeat gate. This is an accepted conditional recovery grant, NOT present ownership or completed reclamation, no deed until conditions met. No fee, property purchase, expedition departure, roll or restoration contract. V controls subsequent expedition timing and choices. All party resources full after D326 long rest: V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Cirren51/51 AC19 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 +1 Shield equipped, old shield retained, Boots of Elvenkind; Fenar59/59 AC16 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40, breastplate and Insignia of Claws, natural attacks+9/1d6+6 base or1d6+8 raging, mechanical greataxe unchanged; Mara and horses healthy. Purse2049gp8sp6cp, rations21/feed28, LR0/6. Coris evidence packet in keeper's outgoing custody via Edric; dispatch/receipt/300gp assessment pending; Mara retains authenticated survey, western crossing 48 road+12 rough miles (~3 days each way), optional800gp field milestone unearned. Diplomatic invitation delivered D325, receipt and credentials held, Crown reply pending; separate frontier inquiry300+1300 contingent. Ferrymen's Share boatyard inquiry available; Quenwood life imprisonment upheld, restitution not paid. Both magic commissions accepted, deposits260gp already paid, balance520gp due upon completion target353; Serpent Dart unresolved. Elara Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed, Kestrel custody unchanged. V dice delegated until stopped. At explicit V request to speak to the royal court about Crownsunder and Veyr, party returns to royal correspondence office, presents limited messenger credentials and D325 receipt. Authorized royal councillor responsible for frontier security has received and read original invitation and grants an exploratory private audience; V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar present, no personal monarch audience. Councillor knows actual invitation proposes reciprocal corroborated frontier warnings and possible joint inquiries, without prejudice to Crown claims or disclosing sensitive defenses. Knows from ordinary official records V has interests/property in both states, not private ancestry/relationships or Kestrel details. Ossent position remains suspension of Crownsunder's throne claim as condition of cooperation; councillor is willing to hear argument and clarify proposals, not authorized here to waive that condition or bind Crown. Acknowledges Veyr's expansion is a concern but regards renewed exposure to rival claimant as independent risk; asks what evidence of immediate common threat V can present and what guarantees could be referred back to Caereth. V explicitly directs presentation of evidence and relay of Crownsunder proposal, saying exactly 'Crownsunder has immediate threats from Veyr at its door. And your feud may be letting Veyr expand without appropriate resistance. Veyr may be adding fuel to what might otherwise be a small ember.' In private audience V shows original western Service Directorate regional bureau directive naming Corven Nask, EVERMARCH/CLEAR WILL orders, transfer/requisition ledger, two false-discharge folios and signed trial/injury packet. Mara voluntarily presents her witness notes, Cirren corroborates observed coercion, injury and rescue of eleven, Fenar shows six sealed reagent vials/instrument and corroborates evacuation. V relays the D306 Orseld report read previously (differing rival colors, similar tactics); no physical copy asserted, no proven common sponsor, Veyran false-flag or immediate invasion. Relays the actual D316 exploratory reciprocal verified raid warnings/evidence and possible joint investigations, no sovereignty/claim concession or fortress dispositions, no treaty/force commitment. Actual Persuasion advantage with meaningful eyewitness Help, +6 proficiency/CHA total and Luckstone+1=+7, no Guidance or limited features; genuine d20 faces1,11 keep11 total18 vs predeclared DC16 councillor sponsorship, DC22 additional immediate bounded liaison not reached. Councillor takes evidence seriously, accepts that escalation/distraction is a credible concern rather than established fact, personally commits to present the limited proposal with favorable recommendation to competent Crown authority, not to waive Ossent claim-suspension condition or agree to cooperation now. He proposes independent verification of the Kestrel records and offers to request permission to retain faithful copies for confidential royal review if V consents. Asks V whether he may have copies prepared and raises substantive safeguard question: preliminary discussion without prejudicing claims, no disclosure of deployments, reciprocal verified warnings, how to stop either side using information against the other. All originals, notes and sealed samples/instrument retained with their original custodians; no copies, sample opening, disclosure beyond audience, official authentication, agreed guarantee, alliance, immediate liaison, new commission, payment or further V speech yet. Existing separate Crown frontier intelligence commission and authorities unchanged.  V responds exactly 'A nation biting the palm held out to helps them creates a sure way to have that palm become a fist. They cant afford attacks from both sides. And like it or not Crownsunder is the best buffer Ossent has.' The councillor acknowledges the strategic incentive for Crownsunder to avoid simultaneous hostilities and the value to Ossent of an independent Crownsunder resisting Veyran expansion, without conceding recognition, accepting V's assessment as verified military intelligence, or interpreting it as an authorized threat. He distinguishes mutual interest from enforceable safeguards. In the existing favorable recommendation secured by prior Persuasion18, he proposes for Crown consideration a strictly reciprocal exchange of independently corroborated warnings about actual attacks and coercive operations, withholding troop positions/fortress dispositions, with ability for either Crown to suspend exchanges if misused. He is willing to recommend discussing that limited arrangement without first resolving the rival throne dispute; this is not repeal of Ossent's existing claim-suspension policy, formal royal approval, a treaty or additional immediate liaison authorization. No new opposed concession or roll; prior DC22 immediate liaison not earned. He asks whether V will permit faithful confidential copies of the Kestrel records to support his recommendation; no copy permission yet, originals and physical exhibits remain with party, no new claim about provenance or perpetrator. Await V's response.
